name: Common Cypher Queries
description: Collection of frequently used Cypher queries for Neo4j

queries.name: list_all_people
queries.description: List all people in the knowledge graph
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name, p.email, p.role LIMIT 100

queries.name: find_person_by_name
queries.description: Find a specific person by name
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name CONTAINS $name RETURN p

queries.name: find_relationships
queries.description: Find all relationships for a person
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $name})-[r]->(n) RETURN type(r) as relationship, n

queries.name: find_colleagues
queries.description: Find people who work at the same organization
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $name})-[:WORKS_FOR]->(o:Organization)<-[:WORKS_FOR]-(colleague:Person) WHERE colleague.name <> $name RETURN colleague.name, colleague.role

queries.name: find_by_skill
queries.description: Find people with a specific skill
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE $skill IN p.skills RETURN p.name, p.role, p.skills

queries.name: organization_employees
queries.description: List all employees of an organization

queries.name: shortest_path
queries.description: Find shortest path between two people

queries.name: graph_statistics
queries.cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n) as label, count(n) as count ORDER BY count DESC

queries.name: recent_entities
queries.cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE n.created_at IS NOT NULL RETURN labels(n) as type, n.name as name, n.created_at as created ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: find_by_persona
queries.description: Find people by persona (developer or business)
